basic_info.description: Experience the best of city living at 2601 Post St #1, a stylish loft-style condo that blends contemporary finishes with an unbeatable San Francisco location. Expansive windows fill the space with natural light, highlighting the sleek kitchen with stainless steel appliances. The lofted bedroom offers a spacious retreat with a full bathroom and ample closet space, while a private patio provides the perfect spot to relax. Additional perks include an in-unit combo washer/dryer, plus a dedicated parking space for added convenience.    Situated in Lower Pacific Heights, this home boasts exceptional walkability. Stroll to Trader Joe's, City Center with Target, or explore the charming boutiques of Laurel Village and Japantown. The lively dining scene along the Divisadero Corridor is just moments away, with easy access to UCSF, Kaiser, CPMC, and USF. Commuting is effortless with excellent transit connections, making it simple to navigate the city or reach destinations beyond.
